钩嘴林鵙.m: (bird species of China) large woodshrike (Tephrodornis virgatus)

钩破.m: (of sth sharp) to snag (one's stockings etc)

钩稽.m: to explore; to investigate; to audit (accounts, books etc)

鎩.m: (old) spear; lance; (literary) to cripple; to harm; to injure

鎩羽.m: (literary) (lit.) to cripple the wings of a bird; (literary) (fig.) depressed; despondent; defeated

鎩羽而歸.m: (idiom) to return in low spirits following a defeat or failure to achieve one's ambitions

閩.m: short name for Fujian 福建[Fu2 jian4]; also pr. [Min2]

閩侯.m: see 閩侯縣|闽侯县[Min3 hou4 Xian4]

閩侯縣.m: Minhou, a county in Fuzhou City 福州市[Fu2 zhou1 Shi4], Fujian

閩南話.m: Southern Min, a family of Sinitic languages spoken in southern Fujian and surrounding areas; Hokkien, major variety of Southern Min

閩南語.m: Southern Min, a Sinitic language spoken in southern Fujian and surrounding areas; Hokkien, the most widely spoken variety of Southern Min

閩清.m: see 閩清縣|闽清县[Min3 qing1 Xian4]

閩清縣.m: Minqing, a county in Fuzhou City 福州市[Fu2 zhou1 Shi4], Fujian

閩語.m: Min dialects, spoken in Fujian Province, Taiwan etc
